summary.ru: Past Simple: **V-ed / V2** — законченное действие в прошлом; отрицание и вопрос — с **did**.
summary.en: Past Simple: **V-ed / V2** — a finished action in the past; negatives and questions use **did**.

examples: She watched a film last night.
I did not see him yesterday.

body.ru:
• законченное действие в прошлом
• известно **когда**
• **последовательность** событий
• привычка в прошлом
body.en:
• a finished action in the past
• we know **when** it happened
• a **sequence** of events
• a past habit

examples: We visited the museum last Sunday.
He opened the door and walked in.
Every summer we spent a week by the sea.

body.ru:
• **yesterday** (вчера)
• **last week / last summer** (на прошлой неделе / прошлым летом)
• **two hours ago** (два часа назад)
• **in 2019** (в 2019 году)
• **when I was a child** (когда я был ребёнком)
body.en:
• **yesterday**
• **last week / last summer**
• **two hours ago**
• **in 2019**
• **when I was a child**

examples: She called me two hours ago.

body.ru:
• *did went* → **went** — после did начальная форма
• *Did you saw* → **Did you see** — V, не V2
• *I were* → **I was** — с I только was
• *He didn't came* → **He didn't come** — начальная форма
body.en:
• *did went* → **went**
• *Did you saw* → **Did you see**
• *I were* → **I was**
• *He didn't came* → **He didn't come**

examples: He did not go to school.
